text: Let me explain how the jury will judge your work.
You will be judged on technology, design and business, and on how innovative the idea is.
A tech concept is an idea based on digital technology. It does not have to be a finished product.
There are two prizes: one for best technology and design, and one for best business.
The jury has people from BTH and Hyper Island together with Ericsson.
Hand in your work on day two at half past three, in your team folder on the Google Drive.
Slides or a video, five minutes. Keep it short and show what works.
